name: Woodland Hills
title: Window Treatments in Woodland Hills | John Crawford
description: Compare custom blinds, shades, shutters and drapery at John Crawford Company's Woodland Hills showroom, or arrange a free in-home consultation.
heading: Custom window treatments in Woodland Hills
intro: Visit John Crawford Company on Ventura Boulevard to see materials and finishes in person. We’ll help you compare window treatments for your home, whether you’re replacing one blind or choosing something for every room.

hero_image.alt: John Crawford standing outside the Woodland Hills showroom and pointing to the John Crawford Company sign.
hero_image.caption: John outside our showroom at 22311 Ventura Blvd #101.

introduction.heading: See how the materials look and the treatments move.
paragraphs: A shutter’s painted finish, the texture of a woven shade and the folds in a Roman shade can be easier to compare in person. At the showroom, we can look at those details together and talk about what you like.

John’s background began with installation. That still shapes the conversation: how a treatment fits around a window handle, how much glass stays visible when it’s open and which controls you’ll find comfortable to use.

products_intro: We carry Hunter Douglas and Alta window treatments. Start with the look you like, then compare the fabrics, materials and controls available for your windows.

products.title: Shades
products.text: Compare roller, honeycomb, Roman, woven wood and sheer shades for daylight, privacy and texture.

products.title: Shutters
products.text: Look at wood, composite and vinyl collections, with louver sizes and panel layouts suited to the opening.

products.title: Blinds
products.text: Explore wood, faux wood and metal blinds, along with vertical options for broad windows and doors.

products.title: Drapery
products.text: Bring fabric into the room with custom drapes, side panels and hardware, on their own or layered with a shade.

products.title: Motorized shades
products.text: Compare compatible shade controls and learn how we handle installation and setup.

visit.heading: Prefer to compare samples at home?
paragraphs: We also offer free in-home consultations in Woodland Hills and Warner Center. Seeing a fabric against your own window helps you judge the color, the view through it and the light coming into the room.
We bring samples, talk through your ideas and take measurements. You can tell us which rooms you’re considering and the budget you’d like to work within.

steps.title: Compare the options
steps.text: We’ll look at the light, privacy and appearance you want in each room.

steps.title: Check the fit
steps.text: We measure at several points and check the depth, trim and clearance around the window.

steps.title: Get comfortable with the controls
steps.text: At installation, we check operation and show you how to use your window treatments.

questions_heading: Planning a visit or a project

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment for the showroom?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our Woodland Hills showroom is open by appointment, Monday–Saturday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Call or use the contact form to request a showroom visit, and we’ll arrange a time with you.

faqs.question: Can you help with just one window?
faqs.answer: Yes. John has always welcomed single-window projects. You can come to us for one blind, a room you’re updating or window treatments for a whole home.

faqs.question: What if I need a blind or shade repaired?
faqs.answer: We review the product, its condition and the parts available to see whether a repair is possible. The repair request form lets you describe the problem and attach photos.

contact_heading: Let’s talk about your Woodland Hills home.
contact_text: Choose a showroom visit or a free in-home consultation. We’ll help you find a starting point, even if you’re still deciding what you like.

name: Bell Canyon
title: Window Treatments in Bell Canyon | John Crawford Company
description: Explore custom shades, shutters, blinds and drapery for your Bell Canyon home. Book a free in-home consultation with John Crawford Company.
heading: Custom window treatments in Bell Canyon
intro: See the fabrics in the room where you’ll use them. We bring samples to your Bell Canyon home and help you compare window treatments for the daylight, privacy and style you want.

hero_image.alt: Pale Roman shades partly lowered over broad garden-facing windows behind a curved sofa.
hero_image.caption: Hunter Douglas Vignette® Modern Roman Shades

introduction.heading: Start with the rooms you use every day.
paragraphs: Perhaps the afternoon sun falls across your seating area, or you want more privacy in a bedroom. You may like the view and want a treatment that leaves as much of it visible as possible.

During a free in-home consultation in Bell Canyon, we look at the windows with you, bring samples and take measurements. A fabric that looks right on a sample book can look quite different with daylight behind it. We’ll help you compare it at the window.

link.text: What to expect from an in-home consultation

products_heading: Find the treatment that suits the room
products_intro: Our range includes Hunter Douglas and Alta window treatments. You can coordinate the colors and fabrics across your home while choosing different treatments for different openings.

products.title: Shades
products.text: Compare light-filtering and room-darkening fabrics, along with woven textures and Roman folds.

products.title: Shutters
products.text: Adjust daylight with tilting louvers and compare wood, composite and vinyl finishes against your trim.

products.title: Blinds
products.text: Explore horizontal slats for tilt control and vertical treatments that move to the side of a wide opening.

products.title: Drapery
products.text: Compare fabric, lining and hardware for curtains that close across the window or panels that frame it.

products.title: Motorized shades
products.text: See control options for compatible treatments, including shades that are difficult to reach by hand.

feature.heading: Adjust your shades from across the room.
paragraphs: If a window is above a stairway or behind furniture, a compatible motorized treatment can make everyday adjustments easier. Hunter Douglas PowerView® Automation lets you operate compatible shades with a remote or the PowerView® App.

We’ll help you compare controls and power options, including how you would reach a rechargeable shade’s charging connection. Installation and setup are part of our work, and we’ll show you how the selected controls operate.

visit.heading: The fit deserves as much attention as the fabric.
paragraphs: Window measurements involve more than one width and one height. We check at several points, look for differences in level and squareness, and consider handles, frames and the space around the opening.
For a broad window or a glass door, we also look at where the treatment sits when it’s open. A shade, a drapery panel and a sliding fabric panel each use that space differently.

guide.text: Our guide to window treatments for large windows

questions_heading: A few details before your consultation

faqs.question: Do you have a showroom in Bell Canyon?
faqs.answer: Our showroom is in Woodland Hills, at 22311 Ventura Blvd #101. We serve Bell Canyon with free in-home consultations, and you’re also welcome to arrange a showroom appointment.

faqs.question: Do I need to know which product I want?
faqs.answer: You can start with the room and what you’d like to change. Tell us about the light, privacy or appearance you have in mind, and we’ll help you compare suitable options.

faqs.question: Can I replace some treatments and keep others?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can help with one window or several rooms. If you’re keeping existing treatments, we can look at how new fabrics, finishes and hardware would work alongside them.

contact_heading: Plan a visit to your Bell Canyon home.
contact_text: Tell us which rooms you’re thinking about, or ask for a showroom appointment. We serve Bell Canyon from our Woodland Hills showroom.
